names.note: Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 10 марта ст. ст., «Димитрий (Легейдо), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank words left off. The day's own line declines the forename and gives no surname.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 10 марта ст. ст. closes with: «Сщмч. Димитрия пресвитера (1938).»

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 марта ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Димитрия пресвитера (1938).»

attestations.note: Neither the day page nor name page 9558 carries a life. The name page lists a second day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia; it is recorded here and the folder does not render on it. azbyka.ru, which has lives for some of the martyrs of these years, was not read for him. The day page prints no hymn at all.
